description: Manage SmartOS virtual machines through vmadm(1M).

parameters.name: archive_on_delete
parameters.description: When enabled, the zone dataset is mounted on /zones/archive upon removal. Choices: false true

parameters.name: autoboot
parameters.description: Whether or not a VM is booted when the system is rebooted. Choices: false true

parameters.name: boot
parameters.description: Set the boot order for KVM VMs.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Type of virtual machine. The bhyve option was added in community.general 0.2.0. Choices: "joyent" ← (default) "joyent-minimal" "lx" "kvm" "bhyve"

parameters.name: cpu_cap
parameters.description: Sets a limit on the amount of CPU time that can be used by a VM. Use 0 for no cap.

parameters.name: cpu_shares
parameters.description: Sets a limit on the number of fair share scheduler (FSS) CPU shares for a VM. This limit is relative to all other VMs on the system.

parameters.name: cpu_type
parameters.description: Control the type of virtual CPU exposed to KVM VMs. Choices: "qemu64" ← (default) "host"

parameters.name: customer_metadata
parameters.description: Metadata to be set and associated with this VM, this contain customer modifiable keys.

parameters.name: delegate_dataset
parameters.description: Whether to delegate a ZFS dataset to an OS VM. Choices: false true

parameters.name: disk_driver
parameters.description: Default value for a virtual disk model for KVM guests.

parameters.name: disks
parameters.description: A list of disks to add, valid properties are documented in vmadm(1M).

parameters.name: dns_domain
parameters.description: Domain value for /etc/hosts.

parameters.name: docker
parameters.description: Docker images need this flag enabled along with the brand set to lx. Choices: false true

parameters.name: filesystems
parameters.description: Mount additional filesystems into an OS VM.

parameters.name: firewall_enabled
parameters.description: Enables the firewall, allowing fwadm(1M) rules to be applied. Choices: false true

parameters.name: flexible_disk_size
parameters.description: This sets an upper bound for the amount of space that a bhyve instance may use for its disks and snapshots of those disks (in MiBs).

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force a particular action (in other words, stop or delete a VM). Choices: false true

parameters.name: fs_allowed
parameters.description: Comma separated list of filesystem types this zone is allowed to mount.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Zone/VM hostname.

parameters.name: image_uuid
parameters.description: Image UUID.

parameters.name: indestructible_delegated
parameters.description: Adds an @indestructible snapshot to delegated datasets. Choices: false true

parameters.name: indestructible_zoneroot
parameters.description: Adds an @indestructible snapshot to zoneroot. Choices: false true

parameters.name: internal_metadata
parameters.description: Metadata to be set and associated with this VM, this contains operator generated keys.

parameters.name: internal_metadata_namespace
parameters.description: List of namespaces to be set as internal_metadata-only; these namespaces come from internal_metadata rather than customer_metadata.

parameters.name: kernel_version
parameters.description: Kernel version to emulate for LX VMs.

parameters.name: limit_priv
parameters.description: Set (comma separated) list of privileges the zone is allowed to use.

parameters.name: maintain_resolvers
parameters.description: Resolvers in /etc/resolv.conf are updated when updating the resolvers property. Choices: false true

parameters.name: max_locked_memory
parameters.description: Total amount of memory (in MiBs) on the host that can be locked by this VM.

parameters.name: max_lwps
parameters.description: Maximum number of lightweight processes this VM is allowed to have running.

parameters.name: max_physical_memory
parameters.description: Maximum amount of memory (in MiBs) on the host that the VM is allowed to use.

parameters.name: max_swap
parameters.description: Maximum amount of virtual memory (in MiBs) the VM is allowed to use.

parameters.name: mdata_exec_timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds (or 0 to disable) for the svc:/smartdc/mdata:execute service that runs user-scripts in the zone.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the VM. vmadm(1M) uses this as an optional name.

parameters.name: nic_driver
parameters.description: Default value for a virtual NIC model for KVM guests.

parameters.name: nics
parameters.description: A list of nics to add, valid properties are documented in vmadm(1M).

parameters.name: nowait
parameters.description: Consider the provisioning complete when the VM first starts, rather than when the VM has rebooted. Choices: false true

parameters.name: owner_uuid
parameters.description: Define the UUID of the owner of the VM.

parameters.name: qemu_extra_opts
parameters.description: Additional qemu cmdline arguments for KVM guests.

parameters.name: qemu_opts
parameters.description: Additional qemu arguments for KVM guests. This overwrites the default arguments provided by vmadm(1M) and should only be used for debugging.

parameters.name: quota
parameters.description: Quota on zone filesystems (in MiBs).

parameters.name: ram
parameters.description: Amount of virtual RAM for a KVM guest (in MiBs).

parameters.name: resolvers
parameters.description: List of resolvers to be put into /etc/resolv.conf.

parameters.name: routes
parameters.description: Dictionary that maps destinations to gateways, these are set as static routes in the VM.

parameters.name: spice_opts
parameters.description: Addition options for SPICE-enabled KVM VMs.

parameters.name: spice_password
parameters.description: Password required to connect to SPICE. By default no password is set. Please note this can be read from the Global Zone.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: States for the VM to be in. Please note that present, stopped and restarted operate on a VM that is currently provisioned. present means that the VM is created if it was absent, and that it is in a running state. absent shutdowns the zone before removing it. stopped means the zone is created if it does not exist already, before shutting it down. Choices: "present" "running" ← (default) "absent" "deleted" "stopped" "created" "restarted" "rebooted"

parameters.name: tmpfs
parameters.description: Amount of memory (in MiBs) that is available in the VM for the /tmp filesystem.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the VM. Can either be a full UUID or * for all VMs.

parameters.name: vcpus
parameters.description: Number of virtual CPUs for a KVM guest.

parameters.name: vga
parameters.description: Specify VGA emulation used by KVM VMs.

parameters.name: virtio_txburst
parameters.description: Number of packets that can be sent in a single flush of the tx queue of virtio NICs.

parameters.name: virtio_txtimer
parameters.description: Timeout (in nanoseconds) for the TX timer of virtio NICs.

parameters.name: vnc_password
parameters.description: Password required to connect to VNC. By default no password is set. Please note this can be read from the Global Zone.

parameters.name: vnc_port
parameters.description: TCP port to listen of the VNC server. Or set 0 for random, or -1 to disable.

parameters.name: zfs_data_compression
parameters.description: Specifies compression algorithm used for this VMs data dataset. This option only has effect on delegated datasets.

parameters.name: zfs_data_recsize
parameters.description: Suggested block size (power of 2) for files in the delegated dataset’s filesystem.

parameters.name: zfs_filesystem_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of filesystems the VM can have.

parameters.name: zfs_io_priority
parameters.description: IO throttle priority value relative to other VMs.

parameters.name: zfs_root_compression
parameters.description: Specifies compression algorithm used for this VMs root dataset. This option only has effect on the zoneroot dataset.

parameters.name: zfs_root_recsize
parameters.description: Suggested block size (power of 2) for files in the zoneroot dataset’s filesystem.

parameters.name: zfs_snapshot_limit
parameters.description: Number of snapshots the VM can have.

parameters.name: zpool
parameters.description: ZFS pool the VM’s zone dataset is created in.

examples:
- name: Create SmartOS zone
  community.general.vmadm:
    brand: joyent
    state: present
    alias: fw_zone
    image_uuid: 95f265b8-96b2-11e6-9597-972f3af4b6d5
    firewall_enabled: true
    indestructible_zoneroot: true
    nics:
      - nic_tag: admin
        ip: dhcp
        primary: true
    internal_metadata:
      root_pw: 'secret'
    quota: 1

- name: Delete a zone
  community.general.vmadm:
    alias: test_zone
    state: deleted

- name: Stop all zones
  community.general.vmadm:
    uuid: '*'
    state: stopped

return_values.name: alias
return_values.description: Alias of the managed VM. Returned: When addressing a VM by alias. Sample: "dns-zone"

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: State of the target, after execution. Returned: success Sample: "running"

return_values.name: uuid
return_values.description: UUID of the managed VM. Returned: always Sample: "b217ab0b-cf57-efd8-cd85-958d0b80be33"
